caption_text: In 1828, a teenage boy appeared in Nuremberg, barely able to speak, holding a letter claiming he had been kept alone in a darkened room his entire life with no human contact. He slowly learned to talk and became a minor celebrity, protected by a nobleman who believed he was secretly of royal blood. Five years later, he was stabbed in a park by a stranger who was never identified, and died from the wound. His true origin was never confirmed.
